notes: «عن أخيه» has no name: a relation link (rule 7). The source fills it, which is filed as a fix, not applied.
The Prophet's words end the chain at Samura, the Companion.

fixes.reason: The text gives an unnamed relation («أخيه») between Nuh and Qatada; HKG supplies a name for it that the text does not write.

evidence.quote: نوح بن قيس، عن أخيه، عن قتادة
